name: Horacio Vásquez
contribution: A Dominican Republic military general and political figure who was President of the Dominican Republic from 1924 to 1930.

checks.lead: Felipe Horacio Vásquez Lajara (October 22, 1860 – March 25, 1936) was a Dominican Republic military general and political figure who was President of the Dominican Republic from 1924 to 1930.
